waypoint_accuracy.description: Distance in meters at which a waypoint is considered reached.

rudder_hard_over.description: Legacy rudder parameter retained for compatibility with the motorboat configuration UI.

heading_n_gain.description: Derivative filter gain for heading control.

max_rpm.description: Maximum RPM command for either propeller in the differential-thrust simulation.

min_rpm.description: Minimum forward RPM while tracking a waypoint.

rpm_decay_rate.description: Rate at which forward RPM decreases as heading correction increases.

gps_position_failsafe_time.description: Stop both propellers if GPS data is stale for this many seconds.

rc_data_failsafe_time.description: Stop both propellers if RC data is stale for this many seconds.

heading_data_failsafe_time.description: Stop both propellers if heading data is stale for this many seconds.
